outputs.prompt:
Edit the supplied Neo Modular Desk Clock rendering into a new refined design reflecting the user's exact new physical configuration. The input image is the EDIT TARGET for product identity, materials and removable-module language. This is an industrial design sketch, not a completed engineering design.
Use case: product-mockup, wide landscape 3:2 photorealistic concept board, bright warm-neutral background. One large dominant hero of a clean approximately 4:3 rectangular flat display with clear straight rectangular outline, gently rounded corners, thin even bezels, on the familiar compact brushed-aluminum powered dock. The display front shows a large, uncluttered time "09:41", small date and a small camera preview showing a generic adult face, as well as small ambient temperature/humidity. The display is rectangular, NOT an elongated panoramic bar, not circular. Retain a modular carrier behind the screen and plausible load-bearing supports.
CRITICAL module layout, EXACTLY THREE DISTINCT detachable modules ALONG THE TOP EDGE, clearly separated by seams and visible as three distinct units:
- TOP LEFT: "AI + WI-FI", a small minimal flush graphite cartridge with ONE tiny connectivity/status light. It contains AI/network functions ONLY: NO speaker grille, NO microphone opening, NO audio symbol, no loudspeaker. AI + Wi-Fi is ONE combined module.
- TOP CENTER: "CAMERA", a matching small flush camera module with a clear central lens, physical shutter and tiny indicator, showing the user's face on the display.
- TOP RIGHT: "ENVIRONMENT", a matching small removable ambient-sensor module with tiny perforated intake for temperature/humidity/light and a discreet tiny display or indicator.
TWO DISTINCT detachable vertical SIDE MODULES, protruding gently outward like a pair of symmetrical small ears but refined and slim, not comical or oversized:
- LEFT EAR: "AUDIO", a dedicated detachable speaker/microphone module with elegant dark perforated grille; all audible functions live here.
- RIGHT EAR: "LIGHT", a matching detachable light/status module with soft neutral diffuser and small discrete button. Same height, proportion and finish as left ear, a visual pair.
Total five removable modules: exactly three atop screen and one on each side. The camera is unmistakably centered between the other two top modules. Each should look physically separable by a narrow straight seam, with elegant keyed receiver concealed under the module. No visible count of contact pins, no floating parts in the hero. The AI + Wi-Fi module MUST have no speaker or microphone.
The powered dock retains concept rechargeable battery, USB-C input and USB-C output, and a small accessible wireless phone-charging area offset to the right side without placing the phone directly beneath or blocking the screen or its supports. Include one generic phone resting on that right pad; do not show several devices or promise simultaneous capacity. Keep the core clock and rear carrier visually understandable, refined aesthetic and attainable industrial proportions.
In a small bottom strip show FIVE removable components laid out in a row with short labels in this exact order: "AI + WI-FI", "CAMERA", "ENVIRONMENT", "AUDIO", "LIGHT". These component silhouettes exactly match the hero's actual modules. Add a tiny battery / USB-C icon to this strip indicating possible independent use, without implying every module necessarily contains a battery. Include a small bottom-right inset showing the speaker module unplugged as a tiny separate speaker and the light module unplugged as a handheld light, each visibly usable with own power or external USB-C. No other devices. Precise text:
Title "NEO MODULAR CLOCK"
Subtitle "THREE TOP MODULES • TWO SIDE MODULES"
Footer "DESIGN CONCEPT • Module operation and compatibility require validation"
Use unobtrusive labels and thin leader lines; no other paragraphs, pin counts, power ratings, certified logos or brand logos. Do not introduce any additional modules or audio to the AI cartridge.
